full_judgment: 13. The High Court Division having considered the exhibits as regards payment of rent came to the finding that the last receipt of payment of rent (exhibit-3(s) showed that rent was paid up to 1334 B.S. corresponding to 1927 A.D. and that thereafter neither the plaintiffs nor their predecessors paid any rent. The High Court Division observed that the C.S. Khatian was prepared in 1896 while the A.S. record in 1929 in Chittagong and that both the records were made under section 103B(5) of the Bengal Tenancy Act, 1885. The High Court Division came to a finding that the C.S., record stood in the names of the predecessors of the plaintiffs whereas the A.S. Record stood in the name of the predecessor of the defendants and that both the records have presumptive value.
